environment: Simulation only, no physical hardware. Apple Silicon (M-series), macOS 26.6.2, development machine.
capturedBy: frontend/scripts/capture-sih-assets.mjs (Playwright, system Chrome, ENGINE mode against the real fsoc_demo C++ binary via the production Mission Control build on :4317) unless noted otherwise
methodologyNote: Assets 01/04/05/06/07 use network-level route interception (page.route on the app's own /api/simulation/:scenario request) to append &mode=hybrid&tracker=1 to the query string. These are real, already-shipped server-side parameters (frontend/app/api/simulation/[scenario]/route.ts forwards them to the real C++ engine) that have no UI toggle wired to them yet. No response value is ever modified, replaced, or fabricated -- this only chooses which real engine invocation the page requests, the way a future UI control would.

assets.purpose: Hero: Mission Control tracking AFTER convergence, with Hybrid perception (MODE: HYBRID) and the alpha-beta state estimator (LOCK STATE: TRACKING, CONFIDENCE 1.00) both visibly active in the same frame -- not a mockup, not a Classical-only frame

assets.sourceMode: ENGINE (mode=hybrid&tracker=1, via route interception -- see methodologyNote)
assets.caveats: TOTAL error reads 0.0000 deg at capture (fully converged). No UI toggle exists yet for mode/tracker; this exercises the real, already-shipped API contract the way a future UI control would.
